text.en: People who speak English are called Anglophones. People who speak French are called Francophones. For more than 300 years they have lived together, as partners and in creative tension.
text.fr: Les personnes qui parlent anglais sont appelées anglophones. Celles qui parlent français sont appelées francophones. Depuis plus de 300 ans, elles vivent ensemble, en partenariat et dans une tension créatrice.

source.quote: English speakers (Anglophones) and French speakers (Francophones) have lived together in partnership and creative tension for more than 300 years.

verification.evidence: CANADA'S OFFICIAL LANGUAGES. English and French are the two official languages and are important symbols of identity. English speakers (Anglophones) and French speakers (Francophones) have lived together in partnership and creative tension for more than 300 years.

text.en: One aim of the Official Languages Act is equality. French and English are to stand equal in Parliament, in the Government of Canada, and in the institutions the Act covers.
text.fr: Un des objectifs de la Loi sur les langues officielles est l'égalité. Le français et l'anglais doivent être égaux au Parlement, au gouvernement du Canada et dans les institutions visées par la Loi.

source.quote: Establish equality between French and English in Parliament, the Government of Canada and institutions subject to the Act

verification.evidence: Parliament passed the Official Languages Act in 1969. It has three main objectives: Establish equality between French and English in Parliament, the Government of Canada and institutions subject to the Act

text.en: The Official Languages Act also aims to support the communities in Canada where an official language is in the minority, and to help them grow.
text.fr: La Loi sur les langues officielles vise aussi à soutenir les communautés du Canada où une langue officielle est en situation minoritaire et à les aider à se développer.

source.quote: Maintain and develop official language minority communities in Canada

verification.evidence: Parliament passed the Official Languages Act in 1969. It has three main objectives: [...] Maintain and develop official language minority communities in Canada

text.en: The Official Languages Act looks beyond government offices as well. It works to make French and English equal within Canadian society itself.
text.fr: La Loi sur les langues officielles regarde aussi au-delà des bureaux du gouvernement. Elle vise à rendre le français et l'anglais égaux dans la société canadienne elle-même.

source.quote: Promote equality of French and English in Canadian society.

verification.evidence: Parliament passed the Official Languages Act in 1969. It has three main objectives: [...] Promote equality of French and English in Canadian society.
